purpose: The whole Value card: one component that draws the Plan card of a record of type Value, with its picture, Scale, Endpoint, Qualifiers, Levels and Meter lines and the lines of a Plan record, every read and write supplied by the host.

library.title: Value card
library.note: The whole Value card; for one line take its line unit (value-scale-line, value-levels-line …). Built on plan-card. Plan.Value
